title: hp3 power stability
subject: jarvishp3
note: Silent power-cut reboots, 7 in one day. A new 90W brick did not fix it; stock CPU limits (PL1 65W / PL2 122W) overcommitted the adapter. Capped to 45W/65W with a persistent systemd unit on 2026-09-09. If it cuts again while capped and idle, power delivery is not the cause and the next suspects are the board VRM, the non-ECC RAM, or the wall circuit.
